tests.name: native_macro_catalog_and_index_presence_have_explicit_typed_boundaries

tests.name: native_ordinary_worksheet_edit_preserves_macro_body_and_binary_index

tests.name: native_doc_protection_refuses_public_edits_and_preserves_readable_comments

tests.name: native_macro_tabs_remain_queryable_while_cell_access_refuses_explicitly

tests.name: native_protected_word_reads_but_rejects_facade_body_mutation

tests.name: native_macro_tabs_survive_facade_queries_and_ordinary_cell_edits

tests.name: native_merge_remove_create_overlap_refusal_and_inverse_preserve_cell_records

tests.name: native_inline_revision_dispositions_preserve_property_changes_and_review_parts

tests.name: native_form_instructions_exclude_bookmark_metadata_and_retain_complete_spans

tests.name: native_validation_counts_and_redaction_plans_keep_unresolved_scope_explicit
assertions: Native syntax/root/document checks are valid, with exact field/object/picture/form counts across six fixtures. Known opaque syntax keeps the overall security, external-resolution and execution scope Unknown rather than clean.

tests.name: native_payload_transport_derivatives_round_trip_with_bounds_and_checksum_checks
assertions: Library-generated LZFu and MELA frames preserve every native payload byte on decompression, and retain exact text/paragraphs on package opening. Frame magic, finite output bounds and CRC rejection are asserted.

tests.name: native_logical_tail_append_preserves_source_bytes_and_replays_durable_inverse
assertions: Append two plain paragraphs with Unicode, braces, backslash and tab to seven native sources. Exact paragraph counts and complete text are asserted; every original byte before and after the root-close insertion remains exact.
File save/reopen retains data-store/write-reservation metadata and table counts. Deterministic durable-patch encoding, replay and inverse on a reopened artifact restore exact bytes.

tests.name: native_source_backed_tail_append_respects_write_windows_and_reopened_inverse
assertions: Source-backed publication into a short-write sink never offers more than the configured 17 bytes, and emits exactly the logical append artifact under a 257-byte publication window.
File save, source-byte splice preservation and inverse on an independently reopened source-backed owner pass; original source bytes remain unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Two native source-backed append cases with finite execution/publication budgets; no arbitrary structure editing or native-app reopen.

tests.name: native_tail_append_refusals_preserve_protected_and_dependent_sources
assertions: Protected native inputs give Protected; dropped unknown syntax and external mail-merge dependencies give the exact UnsupportedContent source-proof diagnostics. Failed changes and no-op commits retain original bytes.

tests.name: native_table_cell_transfer_changes_only_the_recipient_literal

tests.name: native_multilingual_text_can_feed_a_bounded_fresh_stream_in_single_byte_chunks

tests.name: native_calculation_windows_and_selections_retain_exact_saved_state

tests.name: native_cell_edit_preserves_calculation_view_records_and_other_cells
assertions: Supported native numeric edit at Sheet1 B2 retains its storage family and reopens as 123. All other worksheet values/formulas and typed calculation/view models are unchanged.

tests.name: native_calculation_properties_have_exact_flags_and_binary_payloads

tests.name: native_calculation_chain_removal_preserves_workbook_and_reopens_exact_inverse

tests.name: native_hyperlink_and_sheet_protection_agree_across_read_routes

assertions: A native chartsheet part cannot be used as a worksheet threaded-comments owner: commit returns the exact Unrecognized package-graph reason. Reset produces an exact no-op and leaves the source immutable.
tests.scope_limit: This qualifies the actual absolute-part owner boundary rather than confusing worksheet order with physical tab order.

tests.name: native_xlsx_thread_models_read_on_both_owners_and_survive_ordinary_cell_edits
assertions: Explicit people/threaded-comment parts are installed through the public OPC layer on native workbook parents. Eager and source-backed reads retain every model field, reply identity, timestamp, absent/false resolution states and the UTF-16 mention substring Bob after an emoji.

File reopen preserves parts. Ordinary unprotected cell edits retain comment/person and macro/legacy-note payloads and invert; the protected native worksheet returns EditBlocked(ProtectedSheet) unchanged. All original parts outside the declared graph additions remain exact.
tests.scope_limit: XLSX exposes typed models/codecs and package readers, but no public package-level threaded-comment editor. Raw OPC setup is test construction, not a claimed source-checked thread CRUD API or legacy-placeholder generator. No collaboration service or fresh Excel validation is performed.

tests.name: native_xlsx_mentions_without_text_are_refused_by_model_and_package_readers
assertions: A malformed native-parent comment part with mentions but no text is rejected by eager and source-backed worksheet reads. The model validator and writer return the exact Invalid reason too. An absent text with no mentions remains valid and distinct; originals and malformed source bytes remain unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: The invalid part is an explicit derivative. This fixes a real parser/validator inconsistency without requiring text on every valid comment.

tests.name: native_xlsx_external_thread_relationships_refuse_without_fetching_targets
assertions: Explicit external persons and threaded-comments relationship derivatives return their precise Invalid errors in both readers before target access. Source artifacts remain unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Relationship admission only, not provider activation or a general network sandbox guarantee.

tests.name: native_docx_task_pane_lifecycle_preserves_native_parts_and_shared_snapshots
assertions: Native parents begin without task panes. Explicit typed additions retain catalog/fallback references, bindings, Unicode properties, pane position/width/visibility/locking, frozen state, inert external snapshot links and custom-function/background-runtime metadata. Omitted containsCustomFunctions val has schema-effective false.

Where the parent contains a PNG, its bytes are copied into a new image part shared by both added panes. Removing one pane retains that shared payload; final cleanup removes it and restores the original member catalog. Native body/worksheet/slide, macro, media and other data parts remain exact throughout, and their effective relationship/content-type graphs are preserved.

File save/reopen, semantic no-op, stale patch refusal, forward replay and inverse pass at each lifecycle stage. Scalar updates retain part/relationship identities and opaque extension bytes. All data-part bytes and member keys are checked on replay/inverse; only the owned root relationship and content-type XML may normalize, with complete effective graph equality required.
tests.scope_limit: Library-authored derivatives of immutable native parents, not native-authored add-in specimens or fresh Office validation. Task panes, references, custom-function IDs and runtime metadata remain inert. No host UI, provider access, worksheet range-binding behavior, custom-function evaluation or add-in activation is inferred.

tests.name: native_docx_task_pane_resource_collision_preserves_valid_staging
assertions: After valid task panes are staged, an attempt to take ownership of an existing native PNG part returns the precise shared Invalid reason even when its payload matches. Earlier valid staging still commits/reopens/replays/inverts, every native data part/effective graph is retained, and source files remain unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: This qualifies the public task-pane package owner resource boundary; it does not grant ownership of arbitrary native image parts.

tests.name: native_dot_caption_lifecycle_preserves_fields_glossary_and_macro_streams
assertions: Native DOT parents begin without caption/AutoCaption tables. Typed labels, chapter separators, location/omit-label/number-format options and ProgID-to-label references survive create/update/clear, file reopen, exact forward replay and inverse. A 40-UTF-16-unit label roundtrips.

Same-value writes are no-ops and stale patches refuse. Only FIB pairs 52/53 and appended selected-table bytes change; original WordDocument bytes, table prefixes, every other CFB stream and directory metadata are retained, including native SEQ fields, attached glossary and VBA.
tests.scope_limit: The template-only owner admits fDot metadata. These library-authored DOT derivatives do not prove the host-specific Normal-template role, automatic caption insertion or fresh Word acceptance.

tests.name: native_dot_caption_invalid_reference_and_label_limit_leave_staging_intact
assertions: Clearing labels while AutoCaption references them returns the exact InvalidFormat transaction reason. A 42-UTF-16-unit label returns the exact Corrupted length reason. Prior valid staging commits/reopens/replays/inverts without changing native unowned bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Caller-model validation and failure atomicity only; no automatic captions or macros run.

tests.name: native_doc_caption_edit_refuses_the_non_template_owner
assertions: Native ordinary DOC files have fDot=false and zero caption table lengths. The public editor returns its precise Corrupted Normal-template-only reason and preserves original bytes.
tests.scope_limit: [MS-DOC] 2.5.6 requires zero caption lengths when fDot=0 and defines these records for the Normal template. The test preserves the documented package-owner boundary rather than manufacturing a DOC caption write.

tests.name: native_doc_and_macro_dot_envelope_lifecycle_retains_typed_and_opaque_payloads
assertions: Explicit Office 8 Unicode and Office 6 ANSI envelope metadata preserves typed recipients, raw ANSI bytes, attachments, security intent flags, opaque tails and all other fields. A subject update retains the rest of the message. An invalid Office 8 collection removal leaves prior staging unchanged.

Unknown CLSIDs retain exact opaque bytes and refuse message-only updates unchanged. No-op/stale handling and removal pass file reopen, forward replay and whole-package inverse. Only FIB pair 97 and appended table data change; all native text, streams, original table bytes and directory metadata remain exact.
tests.scope_limit: Library-authored inert envelope additions. Signed/encrypted intent flags do not establish cryptographic protection; no mail transport, recipient resolution, attachment activation or fresh Word validation occurs.

tests.name: native_doc_envelope_protection_refusal_preserves_exact_noop
assertions: The protected native source has no envelope; adding one returns Package(ProtectionDenied(Document)). The failed edit commits an exact no-op and preserves the original protected source.
tests.scope_limit: The default protection policy is qualified without bypassing or reinterpreting the native document restriction.

tests.name: native_doc_autosummary_state_is_inert_and_has_no_priority_table
assertions: Native Asumyi state is explicitly inactive: valid/view/update flags false, Highlight view, and desired/highest/current levels zero. PlcfAsumy is absent and its FIB length is zero. Unchanged Dop97 codec publication retains every native DOP byte and the native package remains exact.
tests.scope_limit: This is saved inactive metadata, not an observed Word summary or generated priority table.

tests.name: native_doc_autosummary_record_edits_preserve_the_native_dop_and_other_streams
assertions: Explicit contiguous priority ranges 0..8 level 1 and 8..16 level 3 are encoded, attached through the public CFB owner and read through Document::auto_summary. Priority replacement, invalid noncontiguous append with state retained, range removal and full clearing reopen correctly.

Asumyi changes are confined to its 12-byte DOP span, the PlcfAsumy pointer pair and appended selected-table bytes. Every other stream and CFB directory metadata remains exact. File reopen, public CFB patch replay and exact artifact inverse pass at every stage.
tests.scope_limit: The additions use detached typed record codecs and public CFB publication; there is no dedicated AutoSummary package editor and no summarization, native UI state application or fresh Word validation is inferred.

tests.name: native_word_table_character_caches_retain_exact_sentinels_and_flags
assertions: All 20 native DOC/DOT sources retain the exact pinned main-story character count, two cache entries (0/known and ccpText/unknown), terminal ccpText+2 and a 20-byte PlcfTch. A direct little-endian expected vector matches typed encoding and, for unencrypted sources, the original table bytes. Password-backed encrypted reads retain the encrypted source bytes.
tests.scope_limit: Deprecated saved cache metadata only; no table-cache regeneration or use in document interpretation is inferred.

tests.name: native_word_revision_thread_tables_keep_empty_message_and_style_slots
assertions: Every native file has a mandatory RmdThreading table with one empty message/style slot, or two for review-controls and tracked-moves. Message IDs are empty, display metadata absent, author catalogs exact, and lengths 48/60 bytes. Sources stay exact.
tests.scope_limit: This qualifies native empty author-parallel STTB slots, not nonempty message identities, email-thread semantics or mail transport.

tests.name: native_word_language_and_smart_tag_states_keep_distinct_saved_ranges
assertions: Exact native CP ranges and state codes agree with independently assembled PLC byte vectors. East Asian NoLad ranges differ from smart-tag Dirty ranges, and template recognizer subdivisions differ from language subdivisions. No bookmark/property-bag tables are present; source files remain unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: Saved proofing/recognizer metadata only. No language detection, recognizer execution, smart-tag property-bag semantics or native UI behavior is claimed.

tests.name: native_word_recognizer_transaction_changes_only_its_owned_range_and_inverts
assertions: Native recognizer-only snapshots now open and preserve their final producer sentinel. A state edit commits through the public snapshot transaction; disconnected ranges refuse precisely without losing valid staging. No-op, stale patch, exact semantic replay/inverse and unchanged FIB are checked.

Public CFB publication changes only the declared recognizer table range; every other stream byte, directory metadata and document text is exact. File reopen and exact artifact inverse pass, and language proofing state is unchanged.
tests.scope_limit: The typed smart-tag transaction owns FIB/table metadata; publication uses the public CFB owner. It does not imply a high-level smart-tag package mutator, recognition or fresh Word acceptance.

tests.name: native_word_language_codec_edits_leave_other_proofing_and_recognizer_state_exact
assertions: A checked detached LanguageAutoDetect table update sets only the first saved state to Clean. The selected native PLC is published through the public CFB owner with exact unaffected spelling/grammar/recognizer metadata, other streams/directory state and source bytes. File reopen/replay/inverse and detached language-table removal preserve the distinct owner scopes.
tests.scope_limit: Detached record editing and explicit CFB publication only; the metadata does not execute language detection or claim a dedicated proofing package editor.

tests.name: native_word_recognizer_catalog_accepts_absent_and_state_only_graphs
assertions: The full corpus has exactly nine recognizer tables with pinned record counts and no factoid bookmarks/property stores. The other eleven return no smart-tag metadata. All 19 unencrypted sources admit exact no-op snapshots, including absent and recognizer-only graphs; the encrypted source remains read-only in this test.
tests.scope_limit: This corrects the old UI-only evidence classification for the saved recognizer state. It does not qualify absent bookmark/property-bag semantics.

tests.name: native_word_recognizer_point_ranges_preserve_the_source_terminal
assertions: A duplicate-CP point range remains valid. Moving the native terminal sentinel or an actual range start outside counted document positions returns the precise Invalid reason and preserves staging. Publication/reopen and exact snapshot/CFB inverses retain the original terminal.
tests.scope_limit: The source terminal may be preserved past the counted stories as already admitted by the reader; edits cannot invent or retarget that sentinel. Other range boundaries and continuity remain checked.
